title: Depositing a Check Into Your Account
summary: Explains how to deposit a check into a Rho-Bank checking or savings account via Mobile Check Deposit. Uses the deposit_check_3847(account_id, check_amount) tool to start the flow; customers photo the front/back in the app. Standard deposits are typically available in 1–2 business days; funds depend on account type/amount, with possible extended review.
